Hi Redwood team,

We just completed a self-serve signup and are evaluating vendors for a private/VPC deployment for a regulated workload. Key constraints: tenant isolation (single-tenant VPC), SOC 2 attestation, and network egress controls. We're particularly interested in how Redwood handles private deployments, KMS integration, and audit logs for compliance.

Can someone set up a short technical demo (30–45m) focused on architecture and compliance controls? Prefer next week in the morning (ET) if possible. I have our security reviewer on copy (security@medsecure.com).

Thanks,

Hi Sylvia — thanks for signing up and for the detail. I'm Aditya on the SDR team — happy to coordinate.

Couple quick clarifying Qs so we scope the right session:
- Audience: will this be just security + infra (highly technical) or include product/POC owners?
- Do you need a brief pricing/architecture overview plus a deeper SE-led segment, or a pure technical deep-dive?

Suggested cadence: 10–15 minute intro from us (AE + brief business fit), then 30m SE walkthrough (architecture, KMS, audit logs, and tenant isolation examples), and 10m Q&A. Total 50–60m, but we can compress to 30–45m if you prefer.

I looped Laura (AE) to lead commercial context and Marcus (SE) for the technical handshake — Marcus will propose times.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Wed 5/19 10:00–11:00 ET
- Thu 5/20 09:00–10:00 ET

If those don't work, send a couple of times that do and we'll confirm. Also: if you have a short security questionnaire or specific evidence requests (SOC 2 report, audit log retention policy), send them and we'll attach the relevant stubs ahead of the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
